meta.about: Shared content for the choose-gallery wireframes. Not real data: products are placeholders (Machine B, Desk C…) on purpose, as in choose-board. Every proposal reads the same subjects and scenarios through assets/gallery-kit.js; only the mechanism differs.
meta.subject: id; title (≤ 120 characters, WG-3); status exploring | decided | bought (CR-24); createdAt; lastOpened (app-side state, WG-35)
meta.needs: total need nodes (not dismissed) and how many are answered (CR-21)
meta.criteria: counts by state: must | nice | open (still to rank) | irrelevant
meta.products: counts by state, the chosen one excluded: candidate | shortlisted | rejected
meta.compareGaps: empty Compare cells for the shortlisted products × must criteria (CR-61)
meta.chosen: the chosen product or null: name, one key fact, price as an indication with where and when it was seen (CR-41)
meta.history: status changes, oldest first: {status, at, product?, unchosen?}. Un-choosing a product returns the subject to exploring and is kept here (CR-24)
meta.statsSummary: CR-25: "<needs> needs · <criteria> criteria · <shortlisted> shortlisted", where criteria = every criterion not dismissed (must + nice + open + irrelevant) and shortlisted = shortlisted + chosen. Computed by the kit, never stored.
meta.missing: what is still missing before a decision, counted with the board rule (CR-61 as decided 2026-10-14): open needs, no must criterion, open criteria, fewer than 2 shortlisted with nothing chosen, Compare gaps (1 item). 0 and exploring = ready for the recommendation. Computed by the kit.
meta.graph: node counts by kind (CR-20) for a static thumbnail; nodes = all nodes except dismissed
meta.tokens: in / out of the generation log (WG-31); model = main model (WG-32); tone; generations (WG-36); running = a generation is running now (WG-66)
meta.direction: the Welcome direction (CR-13), empty when none
meta.note: why this subject is in the set (prototype only, never shown as content)
meta.scenarios: subject id lists for the prototype switcher: empty, one, typical (the hard cases), many (all)
